dataModels.name: ParkingTicket
dataModels.description: Stores parking ticket information including violation details, vehicle data, and payment status

fields.name: ticketNumber

fields.name: licensePlate

fields.name: violationType

fields.description: Fine amount in dollars

fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

dataModels.name: Payment

fields.name: id

fields.name: ticketId

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod

fields.name: transactionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the payment was processed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (completed, pending, failed, refunded)

routing.reasoning: Complex municipal system with 7-step workflow including conditional appeals process, multiple user roles (officers, admins, violators), and parallel paths for payment/appeals. Requires SQL for relational ticket/payment/user data, advanced forms for validation and file uploads, mobile-first for officer field use, and cross-platform deployment for broad accessibility. Domain is approval-based due to appeal review and ticket validation processes.
